INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar 2.3.1 Singular and Plural Forms Singular and Plural forms of words and s.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 2.3.1 Singular and Plural Forms Singular and Plural forms of words and s.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar 2.3.1 Singular and Plural Forms Singular and Plural forms of words and s.
